main.description: A nomination of one Bluesky account into skymash's head-to-head comparison pool. Eligibility (a minimum mutual-follow "cluster score", not a follower count) is checked client-side before this record is ever written, so its mere existence means the nominator's browser saw the subject clear the bar at nomination time. One record per (nominator, subject) — the record key is the subject's DID, so re-nominating the same account just overwrites in place rather than creating a duplicate. Different nominators nominating the same subject each get their own record; the pool is the de-duplicated union across every nominator's repo, read back via listReposByCollection. Written and read by skymash (https://skymash.bisks.net).

subject.description: The nominated account's DID. Also this record's own rkey.

handle.description: The nominated account's handle, snapshotted at nomination time for display without an extra lookup.

score.description: The subject's mutual-follow pool size at nomination time — skymash's "cluster score" eligibility check, computed the same way as the sites/simcluster* family (mutuals, widened to follows if the mutual pool is too thin). Community positioning, not raw follower count. The nomination form requires this to be at least 40 before it will write the record.

nominatedAt.description: When this nomination was written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
